annotations.title: Create a Google Ads Performance Max campaign

description: Build a PERFORMANCE MAX campaign — Google’s cross-surface campaign type (Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, Maps). ALWAYS created PAUSED; it spends NOTHING until you enable it with set_google_ads_status(confirm:true). PMax has NO manual bidding and NO keywords: it bids only on conversions, so the account MUST already have a conversion action — check with list_google_ads_conversion_actions, because this REFUSES rather than build a campaign that cannot optimise. Creative lives in an ASSET GROUP, and Google’s minimums are enforced before anything is sent: 3–15 headlines (≤30 chars), 1–5 longHeadlines (≤90), 2–5 descriptions (≤90), one businessName (≤25), at least one LOGO (1:1), one MARKETING_IMAGE (1.91:1) and one SQUARE_MARKETING_IMAGE (1:1) — upload the images with upload_google_ads_asset first and pass their asset resource names. A YouTube video is optional (Google generates one from the asset group if you omit it). Brand guidelines: since Google Ads API v21 they are ON by default for new PMax campaigns, which means the businessName and LOGO assets are linked to the CAMPAIGN (CampaignAsset), not to the asset group — Hermoso does that for you. Leave brandGuidelinesEnabled alone unless the user wants the older asset-group layout, and pass false for that. Budget, campaign, location/language targeting, the asset group and every asset link go up in ONE ATOMIC operation — if any part is rejected, nothing at all is created — and the whole tree is READ BACK from Google before you are told it exists. Print the returned note verbatim; if it says the campaign cannot serve, say that instead of calling it finished. RETAIL/SHOPPING: pass merchantCenterId (from list_merchant_accounts) to make it a Shopping-feed Performance Max — it then advertises the WHOLE feed (one root listing group); feedLabel narrows it to a single feed. Partitioning the feed by brand/category/custom label is NOT built and is refused by name, so a caller can never believe they narrowed it when they did not.

assetGroup.description: the creative — Google requires every field above before a PMax campaign can serve

finalUrls.description: the landing page(s) — at least one

landscapeLogos.description: optional 4:1 LANDSCAPE_LOGO asset resource names — LOGO + LANDSCAPE_LOGO may total at most 5

logoAssets.description: at least one 1:1 LOGO asset resource name from upload_google_ads_asset

marketingImages.description: at least one 1.91:1 asset resource name

searchThemes.description: signals: up to 50 search themes (keyword-like hints, ≤10 words each)

squareMarketingImages.description: at least one 1:1 asset resource name

bidding.description: bidding {strategy, targetCpaUsd, targetRoas}; no manual bidding, strategy defaults to MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS

strategy.description: default MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS — PMax has no manual bidding

targetRoas.description: required for TARGET_ROAS, e.g. 4 = $4 revenue per $1 spent

brandGuidelinesEnabled.description: default TRUE, matching Google’s own default since v21: businessName + logos are linked to the CAMPAIGN. Pass false only for the pre-v21 layout, where they sit on the asset group instead

containsEuPoliticalAds.description: true ONLY for genuine EU political advertising

countryCode.description: 2-letter hint to disambiguate a city name

customerId.description: 10-digit account id (dashes ok) — omit to use the brand’s selected default account

dailyBudgetUsd.description: daily budget in the ACCOUNT’s currency (historical name — not necessarily USD; 1–100000) — or pass budgetResourceName

dryRun.description: validate the whole tree against Google and create NOTHING

feedLabel.description: optional, retail only: narrow to ONE Merchant Center feed by its feed label. Omit to use products from all feeds

finalUrlSuffix.description: UTMs appended to every click, e.g. "utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc". Omit for our default (utm_source/medium/campaign + {campaignid}/{creative}); "" for none

imageExtraction.description: default FALSE: Google may NOT take images from your landing pages and serve them as ad creative. Sent explicitly, because Google switches image extraction ON by default for new Performance Max campaigns from 2026-12-04. Pass true to allow it; the reply reads the setting back from Google

locations.description: place NAMES ("United States", "Toronto") — resolved for you

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

merchantCenterId.description: makes this a RETAIL (Shopping-feed) Performance Max — the Merchant Center account whose products it advertises, from list_merchant_accounts. It advertises the WHOLE feed; partitioning by brand/category is not built and is refused by name

trackingUrlTemplate.description: click-tracking redirect, e.g. "{lpurl}?src=x" — only if you use a tracker

urlCustomParameters.description: up to 8 custom parameters, used in URLs as {_key}
